items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 12:1
items.html: This is according to the distance of the second restriction from the first restriction, which is the place of the Bina and ZON of the NHY of AK. For the legs of AK end at the point of this world, while the legs of Atzilut end a little higher, in the Bina of the NHY of AK. (Inner Light, page 607, s.v. "a little")
